snippet.title: Fishing Corner - Steam Demo Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3791030/Fishing_Corner

Fishing Corner is now live on Steam!
Wishlist the cozy fishing game that keeps you company while you work or relax:

🌊 Whether you're typing away or winding down for the day, Fishing Corner gently bubbles in the background—ready whenever you are.
🎁 Fill your basket, help the locals, upgrade your gear, and explore diorama-style fishing spots from Greece to Japan.

🧘 Designed for calm and comfort, it’s the fishing game that minds its own business… until you’re ready to cast.

🎮 Features at a glance:
- Idle & Active Fishing Modes
- Handcrafted Mini Locations from Around the World
- NPC Quests & Heartfelt Deliveries
- Fish Album & Gear Upgrades
- Cozy Low-Poly Aesthetic

🧡 Wishlist now and be the first to reel in the big one when the demo drops soon!
Stay cozy, and see you at the edge of the screen.
